label: SafetyComplianceWorkforce process: Order compliant safety materials from vendors — Create purchase orders with qualified vendors for safety equipment and supplies that meet regulatory compliance standards.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ BEST for safety material ordering
- Enables PO creation, updating, monitoring across supplier networks
- Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance
- Supports vendor compliance verification before PO issuance
- REST API for programmatic PO lifecycle management
- Line of Business: Procurement

Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
- Matches requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, compliance
- Creates POs but primarily for matching/optimization

Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1
- Tracks hazardous materials from vendors
- Triggers safety event response protocols
- Related entity types: HazardousSubstance, Incident, SafetyIncident

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
- Monitors occupational safety incident tracking and hazard compliance
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1

args.reason: Directly enables creation and management of purchase orders with qualified vendors, includes vendor compliance verification capabilities, and explicitly supports procurement of materials meeting regulatory requirements.
